messages.subject: Error While running SWAT+
parts:
Hi

I try to run  R-SWAT for SWAT+ model. After parameter sampling, while running swat am getting the following error and outputs are not generating in the working folder.

 I have attached screenshot of the General setting and parameter sampling. Kindly help with this error.

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Error While running SWAT+
parts:
Hi Balajirj,
I have checked with your TxtInOut files and have updated the code to fix this issues. It now should work with the updated code in GitHub.
In short, there are two reasons why it did not work before:

1) Bugs in the reading from the channel output data of SWAT+
2) There should be "calibration.cal" in the "file.cio" files, otherwise SWAT+ will not run with parameters from this file

Let's me and others know if there is any problem
Tam
